technical_requirements: Throughput: typical 75k messages/day with peaks 12k QPS during campaigns; target p95 token-latency < 400ms for deflection short turns (<=64 tokens). Cost sensitivity: target cost-per-resolved-chat < $0.07. Require prefix/KV caching for repeated flows, automatic batching with SLO-aware bounds, per-tenant routing to fallback model variants under capacity constraints. Must support tool-calling for CRM lookups and structured response templates. Preference for quantized 8-bit model variants or distilled candidates to keep GPU costs low. Observability: token-level cost, per-route latency, and rollback traces for any quality regressions.
poC_success_metrics: 1) Deflection rate >= 50% for Tier-1 intents, 2) p95 latency <= 400ms for short-turn deflection flows, 3) unit cost reduction >= 3x vs current hosted vendor, 4) smooth performance under simulated 3x traffic spikes, 5) no P0 security issues in SOC2 + SSO tests.
cost_constraints: Highly cost-sensitive. Finance wants committed-capacity pricing model for predictable unit economics. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations (batching, quant profiles) and a cap/fallback policy to avoid bill shock. Must show per-conversation and per-day spend projections before contracting.
additional_comments: Customer uses homegrown CRM with webhook tooling — low lift for tool-calls but needs standardized adapters. Historically saw sharp cost increases during Black Friday spikes; wants automated fallback to smaller models and regional routing to reduce egress and latency. Interested in an initial Dedicated pool with optional burst to hosted for overflow.
